sections.appearance: Koyuki has pink hair that's tied off into twintails. Her eyes are magenta with a large yellow sparkle. During her initial debut in Bunny Chaser on Board, Koyuki has pink and yellow hair that's tied off into low twintails and two buns. She has a cute little fang on the right. Halo ==== Koyuki's halo is a pink circle with two spikes at opposite ends. In the center is a six-tooth cog. Uniform ==== During the events of Bunny Chaser on Board, Koyuki wears a white tailcoat, a black leotard, a Millennium access badge, white tights, and black high heels. The inner side of her tailcoat is black with a pattern of yellow crosses. Around her neck is a detached collar and the standard Millennium necktie. She wears white half-palm gloves and carries a white and black top hat that is yellow inside, though she does not wear. Instead, she wears a pair of black and yellow rabbit ears, completing her playboy bunny look. In hers playable variation, Koyuki wears: the standard Millennium Scientific School uniform, modified with Seminar's signature outerwear and distinctive practical accessories. Her outfit consists of a white shirt with an unbuttoned collar, a white blazer with a black interior lining, and the school's loosened necktie. Over this ensemble, she dons the iconic Seminar overcoat—a white, oversized field-styled jacket. sections.personality: Arguably the most irresponsible known student in Kivotos. She seemingly never acknowledges her mistakes and almost always considers what she's doing to be right. This nature of hers causes numerous major problems for Millennium. She also often sticks her nose in other people's business, uncovering others' secrets without their permission simply for fun. Althrough, Koyuki expressed guilt and embarrassment when she discovered numerous adult magazines that were confiscated from other students.
